newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-RGC final div to be 84 pct franked.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-RGC final div to be 84 pct franked.

text.p: RGC Ltd said on Thursday its 1995/96 final dividend of 10 cents would be 84 percent franked.
RGC announced its full year result on August 29 and said at the time the dividend payment would be delayed until November 28 in order to determine the availability of franking credits.

"This level of franking has been made possible by access to RGC's share of franking credits in non wholly-owned members of the group," it said. The latest dividend compared with a five cent unfranked payment in the second half of 1994/95.
